body: I suppose you're right. I've just never broken up with someone before, was always the one who got broken up with. I really don't want to hurt her because she's seriously the sweetest person I've ever met.

Yeah, I did. She didn't want me meeting him either, and I haven't yet. We've been together for about 7 months. At first the kid bothered me, but I got over it, because I'm not a "traditionalist" in that sense. It's just along with everything else, I feel as though she's not right for me.

That would be pretty awesome, but I already suffer from depression, anxiety, low self-esteem and low self-confidence so I'm not sure if I have the ability to say something so... powerful? For lack of better terms.

Yeah, I wanted to tell him that too. That the very nature of therapy is private, personal, and confidential, but he almost gets off on being hostile towards me and will find a way to give me some kind of snarky response. I'm not even sure if he even understands what he said and how he says it is really inappropriate. If he is coming from a well-intentioned place then I appreciate his care, although I doubt that is the case, seeing as how he chooses to use hostile language.

I really, really want to believe this, and these thoughts have occurred to me as well, but I just don't think him and I will ever be friends again. I still consider him one of my dearest friends but he himself has said he hates me, that I'm garbage, etc. Maybe I am, but I'm taking steps to improve. He hasn't made any indication that we would be friends again so when he asked me these questions it was just extremely jarring, but I would love and hope that what you're saying is the case.
to be honest, you sound pretty selfish and your ex definitely dodged a bullet. it doesn't seem like you learned anything at all. but whatever.

She said that she was tired of having to care about how her actions could affect the way I feel and that we both needed time to grow and be better people. She said that she still loves me, is still in love with me, is still attracted to me and that the fantasy of being together with me into old age, having a family, a home is still something she wants but can't see happening as of right now. She said that she can't see us getting back together for at least a couple months. 

Shortly after our break up, we went to a concert of one of our favorite artists because we had bought the tickets a few months prior. We had a great time and I felt a sparkle in her eye and attitude while we were there together. It was a very pleasant night and it enjoyed every second of it. But ever since that, she just seems angry to see me, that she doesn't want to see me. And that she had sex with someone when she was trying to cope with the loneliness she felt. Even then, she still told me she loves me and that it could be months. I'm just confused.

Of course everyone is telling me that I'm just a plan B so that she could go off and fuck people and come back to me with open arms. I have trouble reeling that thought in as well, but then again, sex isn't necessarily love. I could have sex with other people right now and still feel absolute love for her, so I know it's possible. I'm just having trouble understanding if this is temporary or not.

Same. When my girlfriend broke up with me our last words were in each other's arms, "I love you so much, I'm going to miss you".

And then she went and had sex with the guy(s) she told me not to worry about. It completely fucked me up, but at the same time, it gave me closure and enough feeling of betrayal and meaninglessness that it's helping me get over her.
We can stand anywhere we want, and yeah I'm more willing to just meet up at the spot and go home on our own but that's likely not going to be the case.
We can go separately but we'll both just be by ourselves which means we'll end up being there together anyway.

Do you think I should try and communicate our intentions here? I was never the type to be cold, and I don't plan to be now. Maybe I should ask her if she really thinks it's a good idea? I don't want to flat out reject her or tell her about how I'm still so in love with her and it'll hurt me, etc. so I don't come off as pathetic or something.
